title: University of Helsinki RESDOC Doctoral Researcher Positions 2026 (30 Fully Funded PhD Positions)
provider: University of Helsinki Doctoral School (UHDS), funded by Horizon Europe MSCA COFUND and University of Helsinki
eligibilitySummary: Early-stage researchers (less than 4 years of research experience) with a completed Master's degree, not yet holding a PhD. Must comply with EU MSCA mobility rule (not resident in Finland for more than 12 months in the past 3 years). Must propose a research topic fitting RESDOC themes: infectious diseases and antimicrobial resistance, biodiversity and nature's resilience, sustainable food and water systems, and just socio-ecological transition. English language proficiency required. Willingness to reside in Finland for full 4-year duration.

fundingDetails.salary: Approximately €2,900 gross per month (before tax), determined according to MSCA COFUND principles
additionalBenefits: Family or special needs allowance if applicable
fundingDetails.researchTraining: Interdisciplinary training across 4 themes, collaboration with academia, public sector, and industry

status: OPEN - application deadline is August 31, 2026; evaluation phase started September 2026

title: University-funded Doctoral Researcher Positions 2026 (Salaried PhD Positions)
provider: University of Helsinki Doctoral School (UHDS)
eligibilitySummary: Open to all disciplines. Must hold a master's level degree or equivalent qualifying for doctoral studies at the University of Helsinki. Must not already be a PhD holder. Applications accepted in all fields of study. Positions are full-time (100% employment).

fundingDetails.salary: University salary scale salary based on experience and qualifications
fundingDetails.duration: Fixed-term appointment, typically up to 4 years, starting January 2027

status: OPEN - application period August 24 - September 7, 2026

provider: University of Helsinki

categories: 50% Tuition Fee Waiver (covering 50% of tuition fee)
100% Tuition Fee Waiver (covering 100% of tuition fee)
fundingDetails.tuitionFees: €13,000-€18,000 per academic year depending on programme
fundingDetails.selectionCriteria: Academic overall assessment, previous academic performance, motivation letter, University strategic goals

duration: 2 years (Master's); renewable annually based on study progress (minimum 55 ECTS/year required)
status: OPEN for 2026 intake - application period January 2-16, 2026
